dataset.note: hash of the read-only snapshot file; the database itself is never copied into the repository

disclaimer: REBUS Lab tests computational mechanisms INSPIRED by the REBUS model (relaxed beliefs under psychedelics) in a simulated circuit replayed offline on recorded data. It does not simulate a drug, subjective experience, hallucination or consciousness; 'intensity' is a dimensionless multiplier of registered parameter changes.

experiment.created_utc_note: see git log; no wall-clock value is part of the result
experiment.evidence_note: Evolution window; same protocol run once. Not independent of the circuit choice (config 5 was selected for its entries here).
experiment.title: AlphaMorph // REBUS Experiment 002

limitations: One recorded stream and one base circuit (circexp config 5, a research genome). The circexp finalist rule selected no configuration and config 5's evolution-window policy value is below c0's: it is not an improvement and results do not generalise beyond it.

The held-out window was already used by circexp's one-shot test, by Experiment 001 (default genome) and by CONTROL-only counts for this registration: the run is CONFIRMATORY_WITH_DISCLOSED_REUSE, not a clean untouched test set. The replication segment (evolution window) is not independent of the circuit choice (config 5 was chosen for its entries there).

CONTROL has zero entries in the held-out window, so entries can only appear through perturbation-caused abstain->enter flips; REALIZED_SHADOW performance is usually INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and never a confirmatory outcome.
H8 pools ONSET+PEAK+RECOVERY and the minimum-sample rules were fixed after seeing CONTROL-only decision counts (disclosed in the pre-registration).
Seeds (8) only randomise the RANDOM comparator; the REBUS condition itself is deterministic.
Shadow-weights (counterfactual learning) are a research construct that never feeds back into the decision actually taken; their effect is shown only through 'shadow decisions'.
Counterfactual outcomes come from fixed-notional paper positions opened at abstentions (selection-biased); they are not trade records.
Decisions of different conditions are matched on (token, decision obs, apply obs, sensory flag); decisions that exist in one condition only are reported as unmatched, not imputed.
Tokens are the bootstrap cluster; decisions of one token are not independent. Observations of the same stream are not independent of the market regime.
Fixed hand-chosen registered maxima; EXTREME sits on the validated bounds (the memory-drive factor bound was widened to [0, 1.5] for this lab); no claim that any level is 'optimal'.

performance.reason: needs >= 15 realized closes on >= 8 tokens in both arms; descriptive numbers are in metrics.per_condition.*.outcomes

downsample.rule: all rows where any shown condition's decision differs from CONTROL (or is missing), plus every k-th row

tests.multiple_comparison_note: Holm correction over the registered primary family ['H1', 'H2', 'H3b', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6', 'H8'] (m = number of tests that could be formed). LOW/MEDIUM levels, ablations beyond H1-H3b, dose-response, per-window metrics and per-condition CIs are descriptive/secondary and NOT corrected: do not read their intervals as confirmatory.

primary.unit: bits (M2 minus CONTROL, matched PEAK decisions)

primary.note: 8 seeds: the RANDOM mean is a coarse comparator; the CI is over tokens, not over seeds

primary.unit: decision divergence rate among CONTROL margin-stage decisions in ONSET+PEAK+RECOVERY (REBUS_HIGH vs CONTROL)
